description: The Xiaomi Power Bank 20000 165W is aimed at users who need more than an occasional phone top-up. Its 20,000mAh battery, up to 165W combined output, and laptop charging support make it a capable option for travel and everyday work. The built-in braided USB-C cable is convenient, while the colour display provides useful charging and battery information at a glance. At Rs. 5,499, it may be excessive for users who only need to charge a smartphone.
title: Xiaomi Power Bank 20000 165W Review: One Brick to Charge It All

description: The Toshiba Z670SP is a strong all-round Mini-LED TV that gets the important things mostly right. Picture quality is the biggest draw, with strong contrast, punchy HDR, rich colours, and smooth motion that make movies, sports, and games enjoyable on the 65-inch screen. The front-firing speakers deliver clearer and more direct sound than many TVs in this segment. The main compromise is VIDAA on the software side. At Rs. 79,990, the Z670SP gets everything fundamentally right, especially for buyers who want a bright, feature-packed TV without moving straight to OLED pricing.
title: Toshiba Z670SP 65-inch Mini-LED TV Review: Bright, Smooth and Well-Balanced

description: The Redmi 17C was recently launched in India with a starting price of Rs. 20,999. It runs on a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 5G chipset, paired with up to 6GB of RAM and 128GB of storage. It carries a 6,000mAh battery with 33W charging support and 10W reverse charging. The Poco M8x 5G has a starting price of Rs. 20,999, while the OnePlus N6x starts at Rs. 18,999. Here's how the three smartphones compare in terms of price, specifications and features.
title: Redmi 17C vs Poco M8x vs OnePlus N6x: Price in India, Specifications Compared

description: Amazon and Flipkart are gearing up for their biggest festive sales, with discounts expected across popular TWS earbuds. Several models are already listed below Rs. 7,000, including the OnePlus Buds 4, Samsung Galaxy Buds Core, JBL Tune Beam 2, Nothing Ear A and Sony WF-C510. Shoppers can also get additional savings through bank offers, coupons and exchange deals. Amazon's sale begins on October 8, followed by Flipkart's Big Billion Days Sale on October 9, with early access for eligible customers.
title: Best Earbuds Under Rs 7,000 to Buy During Amazon, Flipkart Sale

description: Apple Watch Series 12 is one of those upgrades that becomes more convincing the longer you use it. The design has barely changed, but Apple has made meaningful improvements where they matter more. The new Health Sensing System detects heart rate quicker and takes readings more frequently, while the Readiness score finally brings sleep, activity, recovery and other health metrics into one easy-to-understand number. Battery life was another pleasant surprise during my review, regularly lasting beyond a full day and draining noticeably slower during runs than on the Series 10 and Series 11.
title: Apple Watch Series 12 Review: Familiar Looks, Tracks Like a Beast

description: In the upcoming Flipkart and Amazon sales, shoppers can find deals across a variety of smart TVs from brands such as Samsung, Xiaomi, TCL, and more. Buyers can also benefit from bank offers, no-cost EMI plans, and exchange deals. However, finding a TV that fits your requirements and budget can be a confusing task. To make the decision easier, we have shortlisted some of the best smart TVs available on Amazon and Flipkart for under Rs. 50,000.
title: Best TVs Under Rs. 50,000 in India to Buy During Amazon and Flipkart Sale
